feed.title: Foafnaut notes
feed.subtitle: What changed in the Lean browser engine, one entry for each step

entry.title: Spın̈al Tap: a SPARQL client for Wikidata

link.title: Spın̈al Tap: a SPARQL client for Wikidata

entry.summary: A demo page asks Wikidata seven SPARQL questions about Spın̈al Tap, through QLever, and shows the answers as amp-panel cards with dials that go to eleven.

entry.title: crypto.subtle over HACL*
entry.summary: Page scripts have crypto.subtle: SHA digests, HMAC, HKDF, PBKDF2, ECDSA and ECDH on P-256, Ed25519, X25519 and ChaCha20-Poly1305. Lean holds the WebCrypto rules; HACL*, verified C from Project Everest, computes the primitives.

entry.title: WebAssembly in pages
entry.summary: Page scripts have the WebAssembly JavaScript API on both script engines. Lean decodes, validates and runs each module in WasmVM; the browser's own WebAssembly engine runs none of them.

entry.title: A first score over the whole of WPT: 1.75%
entry.summary: Foafnaut passes about 39,600 of the 2,267,658 subtests of the web-platform-tests, 1.75%, counted the way wpt.fyi counts them. It is the baseline for later scores.

entry.title: Canvas 2D, drawn by Lean

link.title: A Canvas 2D chart, drawn by Lean

entry.summary: Page scripts can draw with canvas.getContext('2d'). Lean parses the colours and fonts, builds and strokes the paths, shapes the text and rasterises every pixel.

entry.title: TextDecoder, URL and friends, computed by Lean
entry.summary: Page scripts have TextDecoder and TextEncoder, URL and URLSearchParams, atob and btoa, crypto.getRandomValues and randomUUID, structuredClone, and performance.mark and measure. Lean computes each operation in one call.

entry.title: BubblePopJS runs page scripts in the desktop browser
entry.summary: BubblePopJS, the JavaScript engine written in Lean, is now the default for page scripts in the native browser. The Hub keeps QuickJS-NG in WasmVM. Settings chooses between them.

entry.title: JavaScript: 12,605 web platform subtests, and scripts 36 to 216 times faster on the Hub
entry.summary: Page scripts pass 12,605 of 13,705 web platform subtests, up from 7,788 this morning. On the Hub, WasmVM now translates the QuickJS guest for the browser's own WebAssembly engine, which makes scripts 36 to 216 times faster. BubblePopJS, a JavaScript engine written in Lean, passes 89.2% of a Test262 language subset.

entry.title: WebAssembly runs inside the engine
entry.summary: The page foafnaut:wasm runs a WebAssembly module in the WasmVM, which is written in Lean, inside the engine.

entry.title: Two-finger pinch sets the text zoom
entry.summary: On a touch screen, a pinch on the Hub page changes the text zoom that Lean applies when it lays out the page.

entry.title: Fallback fonts
entry.summary: The engine holds more than one font. A character that Noto Sans lacks, such as Armenian, is drawn from Noto Sans Armenian.

entry.title: Table layout in Lean
entry.summary: CSS tables: columns sized from their cells, colspan, rowspan, captions, header and footer groups. Checked against WPT css-tables.

entry.title: Printing
entry.summary: Lean lays the page out for paper with the print media type, says where the pages break, and draws each page.

entry.title: Images in SVG
entry.summary: The SVG image element, with PNG and JPEG decoders written in Lean.

entry.title: XML pages through their XSLT stylesheet

link.title: A feed reader with no JavaScript
XSLT 4 in a browser: maps, records, xsl:switch, new functions

entry.summary: An XML page that names a stylesheet with xml-stylesheet is transformed by Lean before it is laid out. The feed of these notes is shown that way.

entry.title: Page scripts in QuickJS
entry.summary: Page scripts run in an isolated QuickJS heap. They change the DOM only through commands that Lean checks.
